record.field:
Read-only code structure map of an Odoo model from the code graph index. Shows: which module defines the model, which modules extend it (runtime MRO order), field counts and custom fields, all views with their inheritance, window actions, and methods overridden across modules.
Use when the user asks things like: "which modules modify sale.order?", "where is this model defined?", "what views does this model have?", "which methods are overridden?".
Requires the code graph index to be built (AI Studio > Code Graph > Rebuild Index).

Read-only impact analysis of one field from the code graph index: which views display it, which computed fields depend on it, its relational target and compute dependencies.
Use BEFORE modifying or removing a field, or when the user asks "what happens if I change field X?", "where is this field used?".
Requires the code graph index to be built (AI Studio > Code Graph > Rebuild Index).

Read-only call hierarchy of one Python method (like an IDE's Call Hierarchy): what it calls (downward, recursive) and what calls it (upward, including view buttons). Each entry shows module and file:line.
Use when the user asks: "what happens when method X runs?", "what does the confirm button do?", "who calls this method?", "trace the flow of ...".
Workflow tip: use 'Code Graph: Model Map' first to find method names, then this tool to trace the chain. Only custom addons are deep-indexed.
